messages:
tara: quick follow-up to the onboarding RFC: some quantized artifacts pass unit checks but spike on tail when prefix caching toggles. seen this?

alex: which step? lightweight preflight or full microbench?

tara: lightweight preflight. median ok, p95/p99 2-3x for sequences that flip the cache boundary.

maria: could be kernel selection. quantized builds sometimes lack the fast attention path.

ranjit: we need kernel traces. sandbox hides names today but we can add an opt-in scrubbed trace.

ben: ingest can add a flat exec_hints blob (enum fields + prefetch_boundary). routers will treat unknown as conservative.

tara: propose two lanes: quick-accept (canary, QPS cap, require exec_hints) and deep-verify (expanded bench + kernel trace). auto-enqueue deep-verify if p95 > guard.

alex: I'll draft minimal router pre-filter to respect exec_hints.

maria: I'll expand golden inputs for cache-bound dialog patterns.

bench-bot: quick-preflight qx-9: pass functional, median=20ms, p95=260ms (guard=130ms). deep-verify queued.

tara: action owners: ben+alex exec_hints schema, ranjit tracing opt-in, maria golden set, tara coordinate RFC addendum. sync Fri.
